note: Researched narrative candidates (briefs/2026-08-10-flagship-shelf-research.md) serving as the 360 map's shadow inventory. shadow_id here = the topic_id the tile gets if founded.

candidates.name: The AI Bubble Watch
candidates.claim_hint: AI valuations and capex are a debt-fueled, circular-financing bubble that pops and takes the market with it.

candidates.name: The Grid Reckoning
candidates.claim_hint: AI datacenters are breaking the grid and inflating ordinary electric bills — the buildout or the grid gives way first.

candidates.name: The White-Collar Bloodbath Ledger
candidates.claim_hint: AI wipes out a huge share of white-collar work — starting with entry-level — within a countable number of years.

candidates.name: The AGI Deadline Slip
candidates.claim_hint: AGI arrives on a nameable date ('AGI by 2027') — counter: every stated timeline keeps slipping.

candidates.name: The Robot Butler Countdown
candidates.claim_hint: Humanoid robots in ordinary homes within a year or two — counter: teleoperated vaporware, 'selling the dream'.

candidates.name: Silver Squeeze Watch
candidates.claim_hint: Paper suppression plus supply deficits force violent repricing — COMEX runs out, $100+ silver is the start.

candidates.name: Japan Carry-Trade Doom
candidates.claim_hint: Surging JGB yields force the yen carry trade to unwind, draining the liquidity that secretly funded US markets.

candidates.name: The Everything Bubble Pops
candidates.claim_hint: Cheap money inflated all assets simultaneously; the synchronized pop will be worse than 1929 and 2008 combined.

candidates.name: De-Dollarization Doom Clock
candidates.claim_hint: BRICS rails and record central-bank gold buying end dollar dominance — a run on the dollar begins in 2026.

candidates.name: The GLP-1 Society
candidates.claim_hint: GLP-1 drugs will be taken by a huge share of the population and reshape food, addiction and aging — counter: mass-medicating with unknown long-term costs.

candidates.name: Seed Oil Wars
candidates.claim_hint: Industrial seed oils are a root cause of chronic disease; replace with tallow — counter: evidence indicts ultraprocessed food, not linoleic acid.

candidates.name: Longevity Escape Velocity
candidates.claim_hint: Aging is an engineering problem about to be solved; the first person to live to 150 is already alive — counter: biological fantasy.

candidates.name: Plastic In Your Brain
candidates.claim_hint: Microplastics have invaded blood and brains ('a spoon's worth'), linked to dementia — counter: contamination artifacts, a manufactured panic.

candidates.name: AI Will End Disease
candidates.claim_hint: AI compresses decades of drug discovery into years — 'cure all disease' within a decade; counter: the bottleneck is trials, not compute.

candidates.name: Midterm Wave Watch 2026
candidates.claim_hint: The November 2026 midterms will be a wave — blue-wave flip vs 'increase our margins'.

candidates.name: Taiwan 2027 Countdown
candidates.claim_hint: China ready to — and may — invade or blockade Taiwan by 2027 (the Davidson Window); counter: readiness benchmark, not invasion date.

candidates.name: NATO Attack Window 2027-2030
candidates.claim_hint: Russia capable of attacking or 'testing' NATO by ~2029; Europe must rearm now — counter: threat inflation.

candidates.name: The EV Cliff
candidates.claim_hint: With the tax credit gone, EV adoption collapsed — the transition was subsidy hype; counter: a temporary cliff before takeover.

candidates.name: Nuclear Renaissance Watch
candidates.claim_hint: Nuclear is finally back — SMRs scale fast enough to power AI; counter: same too-late-too-expensive hype as every previous renaissance.

candidates.name: AMOC Collapse Watch
candidates.claim_hint: The Atlantic circulation is heading for a tipping-point shutdown this century, possibly already committed — counter: likely withstands warming.

candidates.name: The Depopulation Bomb
candidates.claim_hint: Fertility is crashing below replacement everywhere; population collapse is a bigger risk than warming — counter: overblown panic.
